events.pleaseNote: CHILDREN UNDER 3 ARE NOT ALLOWED IN THE THEATRE. Note: No Meals are served Tickets held at Will Call can only be retrieved by the cardholder with original purchase card and valid ID. To reach the UTEP Dinner Theatre, you must enter the UTEP Campus from University Ave. at the north end of campus, off of Oregon Street. The UTEP Dinner Theatre information available at www.academics.utep.edu/udt/

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: University Ticket Center Mon.-Fri. 8:00 am-6:00pm Sat. 8:00am-4:00pm Doors open: 1 hour prior to event
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cash, Visa, MC, American Express and Discover.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call: Available during business hours at the University Ticket Center Day of Show: Box Office located in the UTEP Dinner Theatre lobby opens one hour prior to event. Picture ID and the credit card used to order the tickets will be required.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking is free on campus. During classes parking is limited.
